relics: A master rivet repairs worn equipment and nearby supports together, but the resisting work leaves the bearer fatigued.
A strange ironstone strips nearby human weapons into one recoverable pile—including the courier's readied weapon—and rings an alarm.
A sailcloth clasp gives eight actions of lee from a storm's push and glare; its snap alerts nearby listeners.
A weighted line carries the courier over a straight marked water lane; the heaviest cargo stays at the launch and the landing is loud.
